DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (Infantile Cradle Cap)

Although the family history of psoriasis and the red, scaly appearance during cold weather are concerning for psoriasis, the patient's very young age (3 months) and history of being generally healthy since birth make seborrheic dermatitis the most likely clinical diagnosis. I would like to confirm this; can you show me the rash, and if possible, provide a close-up image?
